access: Only existing admitted reports, owned source packets and explicit whole-unit proposal fields. No images, reserves, new admission, target test, decoder, outside contact, GDT creation, global refresh, staging or commit. Prior exposure is retained; this is not blinded.
claim_ceiling: A construction offer for a previously authored whole reading, not new historical source evidence, a completed derivation, or a confirmed word. Review is required before selection.
title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one role-transform construction derives paired event and time references in the whole music reading
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. In the complete existing GDT1026 music account, ask whether r al r and the separate qokaiin applications can be generated by one typed role-transform/application construction, without occurrence-indexed operand lists or any new word value. Keep all 150 projected positions and all diplomatic gaps. This is a missing-derivation offer, not another performance simulation or the closed music91 extension census.

design.mechanism: An explicit bound performer x can be transformed by a written role relation R, then the same function F is applied to x and R(x). A proposed F R F construction denotes the ordered pair (F(x),F(R(x))); a written unary function on an explicit performer pair is lifted pointwise. Scope and argument supply must follow the written construction, not target position IDs.
design.unit: All existing 150 projected positions of GDT1026: f83r.25-30, f83r.31-44, f76v.37-41. The last 55-group complete ZL paragraph owns the decisive r/al/r and qokaiin examples. Existing diplomatic alternatives remain compulsory and unbound where the parent is unbound.
design.contrast: One role-transform/application construction with shared argument direction versus two separately selected referents, identity copying F(x),F(x), or a predecessor operation applied to an event rather than its performer.
design.prediction: Written al must change the performer argument before r constructs its event; qokaiin must return the times of those same owned events, not free times. An explicit later LEADER argument overrides a pending-role default by the same application rule and never creates a second leader event.
design.scope: Exploratory manual whole-construction authoring with all 91 parent meanings unchanged; no expanded lexicon, corpus search, event simulator or empirical significance claim.

two_discriminating_consequences: For an already selected later follower R2, the paired r terms refer to its first entry and R1’s first entry, not twice to R2. In the inherited example their onsets are 24 and 12. These old numbers illustrate a reference difference, not new calculations or source numerals. The identity-copy rival makes the written non-co-onset claim self-contradictory.

The later explicit leader reference denotes the existing R0 first event. The two qokaiin constructions must return time(e(R0)) and the separately bound follower time. A fresh-reference or event-creation interpretation breaks identity even if its chosen numbers accidentally agree. No reference call may reset an accompaniment clock.

historical_operation.work: Harley MS978 f11v, complete boxed rota instructions and both red pes instructions, R01-R07 in the owned source packet.
historical_operation.source_layer: Medieval source, inspected in the earlier source dossier; no new image access. Latin expansions retain Canitur/Cantatur, repetat/repetit and dicat/dicit qualifications. Numeric rhythm is conditional.
historical_operation.owned_content: One singer starts with the pes while the others are silent; at the cue another starts and likewise the others. The two accompaniment parts repeat their own prescribed note/rest sequences. Performer, owned part, cue attainment, first entry and its time are different roles.
historical_operation.local_locator: rules R01-R07; R03 and R04 supply startup and successive entry; R06/R07 preserve the independent accompaniment roles.
historical_operation.limit: The source does not write a Voynich F R F syntax or identify r, al or qokaiin. Source-fit consequences cannot select music against every other possible content.

positive_basis: GDT608/318 preserve directed formal composition and entry effects, not meanings. GDT1026 already supplies different explicit argument uses of the same assumed r and qokaiin and full projected coverage. The new question concerns their derivation from a reusable written construction; the old semantic outputs are not new findings.
additional_assumptions: r: performer -> first-entry-event; al: performer -> immediate predecessor; qokaiin: performer -> time(first-entry-event) remain the unchanged parent guesses.
The proposed F R F schema is one new construction hypothesis, not a historically identified Voynich syntax or a general rule for all ABA strings.

The implicit current performer must come from one written binder with a declared lifetime; no nearest-good-type or position-ID fallback. Pointwise lifting over a written pair is an additional explicit construction hypothesis.
All old shared-performance, forward-owner, quantifier and extended-negation assumptions remain paid-for debts until actually derived. No four-rule or complete grammar success is claimed.
strongest_known_countercases: GDT1026 already assumes the desired r/qokaiin references in B3 and lists them in operator_application_contract. Reprinting those lists would be a duplicate, not a new derivation. This card needs a surface rule that could fail to derive one of them.
The known diplomatic IT lolsaiiin and sar/sor conflicts remain; earlier f83 diplomatic gaps remain. 150 is projected coverage, not a complete literal multi-reader translation.
GDT1041 found no complete native paragraph outside development leaves 76/83 under the unchanged 91 values; this card does not reopen that census or claim a new transferable word.

The full exposed profile has r at 124 ZL positions on 70 selectors and qokaiin at 261 on 67 selectors. Their many other contexts are not explained by the local music offer; physical line positions are not argument boundaries.
GDT559 inheritance was produced upstream by the same carrier rule. Its 157/157 count is not independent support for the new implicit-role binder.
smallest_next_step: Manual derivation only: write the proposed F R F rule with typed inputs, exact terminal order, binder introduction/closure and the one pair-lifting rule. Derive the four complete cited clauses in their complete 55-group paragraph, then check every existing use of r/al/qokaiin in the other two complete parent paragraphs. Keep all other clauses and all unknown diplomatic forms visible. If an occurrence needs an indexed operand exception, retain the gap and stop; do not add words or a solver.
